definitions.explanation: An electronic device for performing mathematical calculations.

examples.japanese: {電卓|でんたく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{電卓|でんたく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{電卓|でんたく}⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: To use the calculator app on my smartphone.

examples.english: You can't bring a calculator to the exam, so you have to work out the answers by mental arithmetic.

notes:
{電卓|でんたく} means calculator - an electronic device for mathematical calculations.

FULL FORM:
{電子卓上計算機|でんしたくじょうけいさんき} (electronic desktop calculator) - abbreviated to {電卓|でんたく}

WORD FORMATION:
{電|でん} (electronic) + {卓|たく} (table/desktop) = desktop electronic (calculator)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {電卓|でんたく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to calculate with a calculator
- {電卓|でんたく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{叩|たた}く→叩く：02072_tataku⟧: to punch a calculator
- {電卓|でんたく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use a calculator

TYPES:
- ⟦{関数|かんすう}→関数：04796_kansuu⟧{電卓|でんたく}: scientific calculator
- ⟦{金融|きんゆう}→金融：02664_kinyuu⟧{電卓|でんたく}: financial calculator
- ⟦{卓上|たくじょう}→卓上：22894_takujou⟧{電卓|でんたく}: desktop calculator

NOTE:
Physical calculators remain common in business and accounting contexts in Japan, even with smartphone apps available.
